structure.unit: Drainage, Soil Conservation, Sanitation and Public Facilities Districts

law.catch_line: Alteration of boundaries or reduction of area of sanitary districts in certain counties
law.text: Chapter 549 of the Acts of 1950, as amended by Acts 1952, c. 202, relating to alteration of boundaries or reduction of area of sanitary districts in any county adjoining a county having a population in excess of 2,000 per square mile, is incorporated in this Code by this reference.
